name: Revenue, branch 1, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Revenue], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select sum(revenue_amount) from gold.ssas_fact_charge_line where branch_key = 1 and delivery_date_key >= 20260801 and delivery_date_key < 20260901

name: Revenue, all branches, 2025
sql: select sum(revenue_amount) from gold.ssas_fact_charge_line where delivery_date_key >= 20250101 and delivery_date_key < 20260101

name: Headcount, 2026-09

name: GL Closing Balance, branch 7, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([GL Closing Balance], Branch[Branch Key] = 7, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select sum(b.closing_balance * f.display_sign) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_balance_monthly as b inner join gold.ssas_dim_gl_account as a on a.gl_account_key = b.gl_account_key inner join gold.ssas_dim_fs_line as f on f.fs_line_key = a.fs_line_key where b.branch_key = 7 and b.balance_view = 'posted' and b.period_key = (select max(period_key) from gold.ssas_fact_gl_balance_monthly where branch_key = 7 and period_end_date_key >= 20260801 and period_end_date_key < 20260901)

name: Hospital NPS (5-point), 2026
sql: select (sum(is_promoter) - sum(is_detractor)) * 100 / count() from gold.ssas_fact_survey_answer where nps_role = 'Hospital NPS' and visit_date_key >= 20260101 and visit_date_key < 20270101

name: Invitations, 2026

name: Response Rate %, 2026
sql: select countIf(is_responded = 'Yes') / count() from gold.ssas_fact_survey_response where is_primary_for_encounter = 'Yes' and visit_date_key >= 20260101 and visit_date_key < 20270101
